title: Embedding Drift in Code Vulnerability Models Under Intended Behaviour-Preserving Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2609.21203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code edits that preserve program behaviour can shift frozen code embeddings across classifier decision boundaries, causing correctly detected vulnerabilities to be predicted as benign. Such instability is problematic because semantically neutral changes, including comment removal, insertion of unreachable code, variable renaming, and loop rewriting, should not alter a model's security judgment. We investigate this issue using 15,000 C/C++ functions organized as 7,500 vulnerable-patched pairs from the Big-Vul dataset. Four mutation tracks are applied to both vulnerable and benign samples: comment removal, unreachable code insertion, variable renaming, loop rewriting, and a combined setting that applies all transformations. Using frozen microsoft/codebert-base embeddings with six downstream classifiers, we evaluate the robustness of vulnerability predictions and introduce a train-only defence that projects clean and mutated representations

translated_title: 预期行为保持变换下代码漏洞模型的嵌入漂移
translated_abstract: 保持程序行为的代码编辑可能会使冻结的代码嵌入跨越分类器的决策边界，导致原本被正确检测出的漏洞被预测为良性。这种不稳定性是有问题的，因为语义中性的更改——包括删除注释、插入不可达代码、变量重命名和循环重写——本不应改变模型的安全判断。我们使用来自Big-Vul数据集的15,000个C/C++函数（组织为7,500个漏洞-修复对）来研究这一问题。我们对漏洞样本和良性样本应用了四种变异方式：注释删除、不可达代码插入、变量重命名、循环重写，以及应用所有变换的组合设置。基于冻结的microsoft/codebert-base嵌入和六个下游分类器，我们评估了漏洞预测的鲁棒性，并引入了一种仅用于训练阶段的防御方法，该方法将干净样本和变异样本的表示投影到统一的表示空间中。
tldr: 该论文揭示了删除注释、插入不可达代码、变量重命名和循环重写等保持程序行为的语义中性代码变换，会使基于冻结CodeBERT嵌入的漏洞检测模型预测结果发生翻转，并提出了一种仅用于训练阶段的投影防御方法来缓解这种不稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that behaviour-preserving code transformations—such as comment removal, unreachable code insertion, variable renaming, and loop rewriting—can shift frozen code embeddings across classifier decision boundaries and flip vulnerability predictions, and proposes a train-only projection defence to mitigate this instability.
